name: Unnamed Bus System Project
bullets: Contributed to the creation of an integrated hardware and software system to track a transit bus's position and route, as well as provide a console for the bus driver to interact with the system
Designed and wrote the program flow for the driver console in C; uses a simplified state-machine design pattern that makes use of function pointers to encapsulate each state
Use CMake to cross compile for RP2040 on the Raspberry Pi Pico
